verdict.rationale: You create a named Bot by describing its job, and it keeps its own memory, files, skills and preferences across sessions. Bots can be duplicated or shared as templates, and Team Bots get their own handle for shared channel use. A month-long user confirms that each bot owns its own context, domain and skills. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of attaching a curated knowledge base or editing a persistent instruction/system prompt, and details on template-sharing mechanics (scope, permissions, public vs. team sharing).
